historical_executions.label: TokAN accent normalization on three L1-accented English clips
historical_executions.scope: Three short demo clips, three speakers and three L1 groups, run offline on one Apple M1 CPU with the same clip as the speaker reference. Whisper-tiny transcript equality and Resemblyzer cosine are proxies; there is no blinded listening, manual transcript, target-accent gold or sustained-stream timing. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Six-class accent classifier on source and TokAN output
historical_executions.scope: A six-class English accent classifier over three source/output pairs. Training is primarily native-speaker Common Voice, the added Latin class has about 100 samples and Korean is absent, so the prediction is a directional proxy, not target-accent ground truth. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Seed-VC Realtime one 240 ms block
historical_executions.scope: One first block through upstream Seed-VC Realtime custom_infer on CPU. It is a generic VC path, not the accent-aware V2 path; the output is too short for meaningful ASR, WER or speaker comparison and the block is not a warmed-up sustained-stream measurement. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: MeanVC2 40 ms end-to-end inference attempt
historical_executions.scope: The 40 ms bundle was acquired and the ASR checkpoint loaded, but inference failed before conversion with FileNotFoundError for the WavLM speaker checkpoints. No converted audio, quality score or end-to-end latency exists; no unverified mirror was substituted. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Vocos JIT decoder CPU timing on synthetic mel
historical_executions.scope: Decoder-only CPU timing on a synthetic 1 s 80-bin mel input, mean over five post-warm-up calls. It is not accent conversion, not an end-to-end pipeline latency and not a quality assessment. not rerun by this survey.
